title: 8 Best Laser Engravers for Wood in 2026

products.name: Creality Laser Engraver 10W Output, 72W
specs: 10W output, 72W machine power, cuts 5mm basswood in one pass
products.bestFor: buyers cutting full-size wood sign blanks and cutting boards who have a ventilated space set up already

products.name: Creality Falcon 10W Laser Engraver, 15.7x16.3in
specs: 10W output, 72W machine power, rated for 12mm wood boards
LightBurn compatible, offline SD card operation
products.bestFor: buyers cutting thicker wood boards up to 12mm who want a slightly larger bed than the standard 10W Creality model

products.name: Woxcker Laser Engraver 10W, 300mm Enclosed
specs: 10W output, fully enclosed, flame sensor + lid interlock
products.bestFor: buyers doing longer wood cutting sessions who want physical fire-safety hardware, not just an open frame and a fire extinguisher nearby

products.name: Carverall K15 Pro Laser Engraver 10W
specs: Verified 10.36-10.58W output, dual-fan cooling, cuts 12mm plywood
CutLabX free app, offline TF card control
products.bestFor: first-time wood engravers who want a verified cutting depth and app-based design instead of learning LightBurn from scratch

products.name: LONGER Laser Engraver Ray5 10W, 60W
specs: 400mm x 400mm bed, largest in this lineup
products.bestFor: buyers cutting the thickest and largest wood panels in this comparison who have the shop space for a 400x400mm machine

products.name: Algolaser 10W Laser Engraver and Cutter with Rotary Roller
specs: 10W laser, includes rotary roller + riser kit
WiFi/USB/TF card/app, LightBurn and LaserGRBL compatible
products.bestFor: buyers making cylindrical wood items like mugs, rolling pins, or turned pieces that a flat-bed-only machine can't engrave evenly

products.name: Twotrees TS1 Mini Laser Engraver, Enclosed
specs: 3W adjustable laser, fully enclosed housing, no assembly
80mm x 80mm bed, rated for plywood, MDF, bamboo
Bluetooth app (MKSLaser) or USB with LightBurn
products.bestFor: buyers making small wood crafts like coasters and keychains who want an enclosed, zero-assembly machine

products.name: Artilume Foldable Laser Engraver T1 7W
specs: 7W diode output, cuts up to 4mm basswood (multi-pass)
products.bestFor: budget buyers who want basic wood-sign cutting and detail engraving without the cost of a full 10W machine
